uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: AI adoption in sales is a top-down rollout: the company evaluates, procures, and deploys one tool for everyone.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: AI is entering sales floors bottom-up — reps are bringing their own AI the way developers brought their own devices, and policy is lagging the behavior by years.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: Adoption follows individual utility, not procurement cycles. When a twenty-dollar personal tool outperforms the sanctioned stack for a rep's own quota, the rep adopts first and asks never.
